payload.freeze_boundary: source, fixture, selector, route, and gates frozen before any result from this application campaign

independence.membership: all 11 source-derived candidates and all 154 fixtures gate

source.projection_scope: lexical direct-call examples across tracked Rust source, including test and documentation contexts; not an execution-frequency distribution

fixtures.scalar_oracle: overlapping leftmost span and nonoverlapping count
fixtures.alignment_realization: allocate fixture_bytes+63 readable bytes, fill padding with the candidate absent sentinel, choose checked_start=16+((alignment_offset-((base_address+16) mod 16)) mod 16), copy the exact logical fixture there, require checked_start pointer mod16 equals alignment_offset, and time only the exact fixture_bytes checked range

backend.eligible_route: authoritative portable prefix then disjoint tag29 static tail

qualification.baseline: same compiled exact literal through full portable search
qualification.candidate: ordinary production auto-route with a prelinked tag29 object when structurally eligible
qualification.calibration: both variants; iteration count derived from the faster pilot
qualification.completeness: 154 fixtures times 2 hosts times 6 paired repetitions; no omissions, exclusions, substitutions, or reruns after inspection
qualification.pair_validity: both variants in every pair must use an identical iteration count and independently reach minimum_elapsed_ns_each_variant
qualification.fixture_ratio: for one fixture and host, sort the six order-paired static_auto_aot_elapsed_ns_i / portable_elapsed_ns_i ratios and compute (ratio[2]+ratio[3])/2 without pre-rounding
qualification.correctness_gate: every scalar oracle must match both variants on both hosts before timing is accepted
qualification.compile_disposition_gate: all 11 candidates must reproduce the frozen five tag29 object admissions and six exact structural refusals
qualification.eligible_route_gate: eligible early and dense fixtures must return from the authoritative portable prefix with zero static invocation; each other eligible fixture must miss the prefix and invoke the tag29 static tail exactly once
qualification.ineligible_route_gate: every ineligible fixture must use full portable search with zero static invocation
qualification.eligible_route_counts: 10 portable-prefix returns and 75 exact tag29 static-tail invocations per host
qualification.eligible_static_tail_fixture_gate: every one of the 75 eligible fixtures that invokes the tag29 static tail must have a ratio strictly less than 0.80 on each host
qualification.eligible_prefix_return_fixture_gate: every one of the 10 eligible fixtures that returns from the portable prefix without static invocation must have a ratio at most 1.05 on each host
qualification.ineligible_fixture_gate: every one of the 69 ineligible fixture ratios must be at most 1.05 on each host and must report the exact full-portable fallback route
qualification.candidate_and_aggregate_results: diagnostic only; no aggregate can rescue a failing fixture
qualification.failed_cell_disposition: the broad tag29 family is not authorized; no candidate or fixture may be removed after results
